summary: Static code review + tsc + eslint of the merchant notifications parity change (bell dropdown → full Notifications page, mirroring partner panel). Scope files: PartnerApp src/components/merchant/MerchantTopBar.tsx, app/merchant/notifications.tsx, app/notifications.tsx, app/merchant/_layout.tsx, src/components/AppShell.tsx (reference). No tsc errors introduced in-scope. One pre-existing eslint warning in EditProfileModal unrelated to this change. Expo apps cannot be run in this pod, so no device/UI verification was performed.
critical_code_review_comments: MerchantTopBar.tsx NotificationBell: logic matches AppShell (useQuery queryKey ['partner-notifs'], 30s refetch, unread = (data||[]).filter(n=>!n.read).length, 9+ cap, red dot with surface border). Navigation uses router.push('/merchant/notifications' as any) — route exists at /app/PartnerApp/app/merchant/notifications.tsx, verified. No leftover dropdown Modal or unused state.
Minor nit: NotificationBell returns `<>...<Pressable/></>` — the fragment wrapping a single child can be removed. Non-blocking.
Minor nit: destructured only `notifs.data` via `notifs.data`; could be `const { data } = useQuery(...)` for clarity. Non-blocking.

app/merchant/notifications.tsx: thin wrapper `<Notifications embedded />` — correct; MerchantStackLayout already renders MerchantTopBar + MerchantBottomNav so AppShellHeader is suppressed via `embedded` prop. Good.

app/notifications.tsx embedded prop: when embedded, AppShellHeader is skipped and FlatList contentContainerStyle paddingBottom becomes `insets.bottom + 110` (bottom nav clearance) vs `insets.bottom + spacing.xl` otherwise. Reasonable. 110px is a magic constant — consider centralising via a `MERCHANT_BOTTOM_NAV_HEIGHT` export from MerchantBottomNav for future consistency, but not blocking.

Partner re-export app/(partner)/partner/notifications.tsx = `export { default } from '@/app/notifications'` still works unchanged; `embedded` defaults to false there so the standalone page renders the AppShellHeader. Correct.

useProgressiveList is used on `items` (10-at-a-time) and LoadMoreFooter renders at end — matches the referenced partner implementation. The remove-single (DELETE /notifications/:id) and clear-all (DELETE /notifications) with optimistic rollback and refreshBadges() invalidating both ['notifications'] and ['partner-notifs'] query keys will keep the merchant bell badge in sync. Good.
data-testid coverage: notif-bell, notif-clear-all, notif-remove-${id}, notif-load-more — all present and testable.

Pre-existing eslint warning (NOT introduced by this change): MerchantTopBar.tsx:47 react-hooks/set-state-in-effect in EditProfileModal useEffect. Flagged for awareness; not in scope of this iteration.
No tsc errors in scope. Full `npx tsc --noEmit --ignoreDeprecations 6.0` filtered to the four scope files produced zero diagnostics.

success_rate.frontend: static review + tsc + eslint — pass, no regressions
